verdict.rationale: Mailchimp says its Analytics AI explains which campaigns and automations are actually moving revenue, grounded in the store's real sales data. The Magento integration's e-commerce tracking measures campaign ROI, and the homepage mentions insights into conversion funnels, so revenue attribution to specific emails and flows goes beyond opens and clicks. Missing for 10: evidence of attributing non-purchase signups to specific emails or flows, detailed docs on the attribution model or reports, and independent or hands-on corroboration (revenue tracking appears to depend on a connected e-commerce store).
